verdict.rationale: Extend documents per-field confidence scores on every extraction run, alongside citations back to the exact spot on the page. Its confidence-scores docs say to trust high-confidence values automatically and route the rest to human review. However, the evidence does not show that scores are calibrated or describe a first-party human review queue or UI; the only review-related item is a pricing-page 'Review Agent' line. Missing for 10: evidence the scores are calibrated, documented first-party human-review tooling for low-confidence fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.
